reason: Repair cycle 1 resolves all four PR #54 permission and diagnostic blockers, and its focused/local/static checks plus the three current PR checks pass. However, each matrix receipt artifact contains the same root-relative cache-receipt.json filename while aggregate-cache-qualification downloads all three with merge-multiple: true into one directory.
